title: Paired machines
summary: This device is paired with three machines: the NUC (answering directly, two conversations), a workstation answering through the room (one) and an old laptop that is off. Each machine keeps its own conversations and history, at its own address. Change where each one answers, revoke the NUC's pairing, and change its conversations, live. Seeded, to try removing them: this device, Chrome on Mac, and four others on the NUC (Safari on iPhone, Mac de Ana, Firefox on Windows, Edge on Windows) and one on the workstation (Edge on Windows), each with when it paired and was last seen (Revoke; Rename any, this one too); in each machine's list its own Sidevoice too, paired with itself: nuc-salon on the NUC and ana-workstation on the workstation (This machine, not revocable); agents connected, not connected, by hand only (Cursor) and foreign (Claude Code on the workstation); the models in use and three not used for 12, 45 and 120 days (Delete); ElevenLabs' key connected, OpenAI's not. New: Codex just found on the NUC, and a setting from What's new (set up on the release before). Seeded too: a transcript in the conversation on top (sidevoice-web on the NUC), six messages to read (the card empties it).

history.text: Morning. Did the overnight build pass?
It did, apart from one flaky test in the settings pane. It passed when I ran it again.
Can you look at why the transcript panel jumps when a new message comes in?

Found it. The panel scrolled to the bottom before the new message had its final height, so when the time and the delivery mark appeared a moment later, the list grew under it and the view landed a few pixels short before correcting itself. That is the jump. It now waits for the layout to settle before scrolling, and only follows new messages when you were already at the bottom, so reading older ones is never interrupted. I also added a test that holds the list at a fixed height and checks where it ends up after a message arrives.
Nice. Does it still build?
Yes, npm run build finishes cleanly. The change is in src/features/conversation/MessageList.tsx if you want a look.
